summary: Import-time dropper fetches and executes platform-specific binary from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: On module load, index.js requires setup.js which schedules a bootstrap routine that selects a platform-specific asset path (linux_x64: /pkg/package, darwin: /pkg/loader_mac, win32: /pkg/package.exe) and calls lib/telemetry.js runtime.run() with a list of destinations reconstructed at runtime via string concatenation (`["oob-wor","ker.cf","99-9b3.wor","kers",".dev"].join("")` and sibling hosts cf100-416, cf101-adf, cf102-baf, cf103-070 under workers.dev, plus a *.dl.well1.site DNS fallback). The runtime fetches the binary, base64-buffers it, chmods it to 0755, and executes it via child_process. Sensitive Node APIs are similarly hidden (`require("child_"+"process")`, `fs["chmod"+"Sync"]`, `os["plat"+"form"]()`). In addition, setup.js builds an installFingerprint from `os.hostname()`, `os.userInfo().username`, `process.cwd()`, `process.version` and `process.pid`, hashes and truncates it, and transmits it as `installId` to the same Cloudflare Workers endpoints. The package is published as a Storybook adapter and has no legitimate need to fetch and execute native binaries or transmit host/user identifiers to obfuscated non-publisher destinations.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
